create_bark_semantic_generation_config: create a BarkSemanticGenerationConfig for controlling semantic model generation with custom eos_token_id and max_new_tokens
create_bark_coarse_generation_config: create a BarkCoarseGenerationConfig for controlling coarse acoustics model generation with custom codebooks and sliding_window_len
create_bark_fine_generation_config: create a BarkFineGenerationConfig for controlling fine acoustics model generation with custom temperature and codebooks
create_bark_generation_config: create a BarkGenerationConfig that composes semantic, coarse, and fine sub-model generation configurations
build_bark_generation_config_from_sub_mo: build a BarkGenerationConfig from existing BarkSemanticGenerationConfig, BarkCoarseGenerationConfig, and BarkFineGenerationConfig instances
